Hi everyone! We are a motivated team of first-year college students participating in our very first NASA App Development Challenge. Driven by a shared passion for space exploration, software engineering, and solving real-world data problems, we are eager to dive into this challenge, learn rapidly, and build something impactful.Why Join Us?
As first-year students, we bring intense energy, a fresh perspective, and a dedicated work ethic to the table
summary:
Project Novasphere X

Project Novasphere X aims to make space exploration easier and more accessible through an interactive web platform. Inspired by NASA's SPHEREx mission, our project focuses on helping users explore images of the sky and understand how celestial objects change over time.

The platform aims to present astronomical information in a simple, engaging, and user-friendly way. Users will be able to explore space images, learn about stars, galaxies, comets, and other celestial objects, and discover the wonders of our universe.

Our goal is to make space science more interesting and accessible to students, researchers, and the general public.
details:
Project NovaSphere X – Project Details

Project NovaSphere X is a web-based platform designed to help users explore and understand changes in the universe using NASA's SPHEREx mission data.

The project aims to make astronomical observations easier to access and understand. Users can explore sky images and observe changes in celestial objects over time. This helps students, researchers, and space enthusiasts learn more about stars, galaxies, comets, and other astronomical objects.

Our goal is to make space science more interactive, accessible, and engaging through technology. The platform provides a user-friendly approach to exploring astronomical information and understanding the universe.
